window_size_policy: Probe sizes are acquisition coverage only. They are not function-body sizes and must not be promoted as body boundaries.

windows.purpose: Primary SCM serialized-mesh read surface. Reacquire continuation walking, color/topology relocation, generated-index workspace handling and every serialized displacement touched by the normalizer. Explicitly census +0x0C, +0x30 and +0x4C rather than assuming zero-corpus fields are globally unused.

Reacquire the primary serializedMesh -> runtimeMesh materialization path. Confirm runtimeMesh+0x10 backreference ownership and direct reads of +0x00/+0x02/+0x10/+0x18/+0x20/+0x28/+0x38; search fresh bytes for any indirect use of +0x0C/+0x30/+0x4C.

Reconfirm texture-slot table indexing, GS CLAMP REGION_REPEAT packing and TEX1 nearest/linear selection with serialized pointer provenance. Record all source/runtime reads so adjacent technical render state cannot be misattributed to SCM fields.

Reacquire SCM object 0x40-stride materialization into the 0x3C0 runtime object. Enumerate every serialized object displacement and every copy/projection of source flags, with special attention to preservation-only +0x04..+0x07, +0x14..+0x2F and bit 0x00200000.

Reacquire the low-mode/helper-state projection from SCM source flags. Trace transformed/indirect bit operations so source bit 0x00200000 is not missed merely because a downstream consumer lacks an immediate 0x200000 mask.

New deeper frontier. Follow helper modes selected by 0x140302640 beyond the immediate source-flag projection. Determine which runtime state is produced by modes 1/2/4/9 and whether any transformed source-flag information, including preserved bit21, re-enters later state without a direct immediate mask. Keep numeric mode identity separate from speculative artistic labels.

Reconfirm SCM header/runtime manager ownership: +0x10 object count, +0x11 scene-node count, +0x13 runtime-carried byte, +0x14 legacy resource code and external companion texture-count authority. Census any fresh reads of the preserved header shells.

Reacquire SCM-resource and external texture-companion pairing at manager +0x108/+0x110 and the companion table build around 0x140304B30. Keep serialized SCM ownership separate from texture payload ownership.

New cross-resource frontier. Reacquire the direct companion texture payload parser around 0x1403365B0, including the TM2\0 check and all fallback branches reachable from the SCM companion table. Establish exactly which companion slot metadata reaches runtime texture records without asserting that every valid slot is TM2.

Reacquire SCM scene-node setup and handoff into the SCM local-transform initializer. Track parent/order/binding/transform arrays from their common binder into node runtime state and look for consumers of scene header +0x10..+0x1F.

Reconfirm four-array scene-node binding and pointer ownership. Distinguish SCM object-binding semantics from MOD node-side semantics and census all reads of the scene-node block header beyond the four confirmed relative offsets.

Reacquire the corrected SCM-specific local transform path: translation, XYZ radians through 0x140330450, Rz*Ry*Rx composition and translation application. Explicitly verify that serialized transform +0x1C remains outside matrix construction.

New downstream transform frontier. Reacquire the generic world update around 0x1402F9700 from an SCM-provenanced caller and prove operand order, parent/root selection and destination ownership through the final world matrix. This closes the reader trace beyond local transform construction rather than stopping at 0x1402FA360.

Regression anchor for fixed 0x50 physical SCM mesh stride and downstream mesh consumption. Enumerate serialized/runtime backreference reads to close any gap between materialization-time and draw-time field usage.

Reconfirm alpha_control projection into the 0x30-byte MDL_PARTS_COLOR_PKT and capture adjacent draw-state ownership. This is a regression surface for object +0x01 and low-mode forced 0x80 behavior, not authority to rename unrelated flags.

New final-consumer frontier. Reacquire the CDrawSCM path around 0x1402FD040, prove the 0x30 packet stride from pointer provenance, and trace which runtime object/material/color packet lanes reach draw submission. Explicitly distinguish packet-level state from serialized fields that merely share numeric values.

New final-consumer frontier. Reacquire SCM draw submission around 0x1402FC850 and follow texture/color/alpha state into shader/resource binding. Record branch predicates and packet ownership needed to map SCM runtime state to concrete draw variants without assigning shader semantics to unproven source bits.

Negative-provenance regression around the previously rejected manager+0xE0 AND 0x00200000 hit at 0x140303F2F. Preserve the separation between manager bitfield state and serialized SCM object +0x10 bit 21.

Negative-provenance regression around the previously rejected runtimeRecord+0x304 bit-21 test at 0x1402F4C21. Confirm independent initialization chain and prevent future evidence laundering into SCM source flags.
